fit: dried mixed berries and state anxiety in healthy older adults
assessment: After 12 weeks the state-anxiety change favored the dried berry mixture versus cocoa in an exploratory Dunn comparison (reported z = -1.88, p = .031, conventionally about .060 two-sided). Within the berry arm p = .185. Raspberry was 16.7% of the dried mixture. The comparison cannot isolate frozen raspberry, and the analyzed volunteers did not have Parkinson disease.
